reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its primary theme is a Chainlink price update and technical chart discussion presented as informational material with cryptocurrency risk warnings. Although it includes disclosed affiliate links requesting registration or deposits, the available video evidence does not establish deception or a misleading outcome, and the affiliate promotion is separate from the chart analysis.

Register now; it takes only seconds; deposit & claim BONUS! OKX Exchange - 10$ on your spot account or 10$ on fee rebate + up to $500 bonus

opening.argument: Judge the solicitation as a whole. The description pairs exchange bonuses with sign-up links, then gives an explicit instruction to register, deposit and claim a bonus. That is a reward tied to a viewer action, not merely a passing mention of an exchange. The price update draws an audience interested in trading, while the description supplies a route for that audience to act on a bonus offer. The record does not establish what a viewer must do to receive the advertised amounts; that uncertainty should not erase the direct promise-and-action pairing.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The chart discussion does not answer what the description asks viewers to do. A technical explanation can coexist with a solicitation; here, the description moves from analysis to registration and deposit for a bonus. Nor does disclosure of a possible commission establish that viewers will receive the advertised bonus on the implied terms. The defense is right that no deceptive outcome is shown, but it treats the absence of an observed outcome as an answer to the reward-linked call to action.

Any affiliate links in the description of these videos may provide a commission if you decide to purchase their products.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted offer says “up to,” and the registration instruction does not establish that any bonus is falsely promised or unavailable. The affiliate interest is disclosed, while the spoken video discusses possible price movements and support levels rather than directing viewers to deposit. A reward-linked promotion warrants scrutiny, but these sources do not show deception.

opening.argument: The warning signs are concentrated in the description: several exchange offers advertise sizable maximum bonuses, and the instruction to act says registration takes only seconds before telling viewers to deposit and claim. The combination matters. Large headline amounts draw attention, a quick-registration pitch lowers hesitation, and a deposit instruction puts viewers' money into the flow. The risk disclaimer acknowledges that trading can lose money, but it does not explain the conditions for obtaining the headline bonuses. A judge should weigh that gap against the force of the invitation.

Register now; it takes only seconds; deposit & claim BONUS!
Investing and trading is risky, and you can lose your money.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense points to a risk warning and genuine chart commentary. Neither resolves the narrower concern: the same description advertises a large bonus and urges a deposit without spelling out eligibility in the supplied text. Disclosure that affiliate links may pay the channel explains an incentive to promote them; it does not verify the bonus claims. The absence of a documented loss does not make the rapid deposit pitch harmless.

citations.quote: DELTA EXCHANGE - 10% fee discount for the first 6 months + up to $30.000 in bonus!
Register now; it takes only seconds; deposit & claim BONUS!
Any affiliate links in the description of these videos may provide a commission if you decide to purchase their products.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Those are reasons to examine an offer, not evidence that it is deceptive. The amounts are expressly qualified as “up to,” the affiliate relationship is disclosed, and the description warns that trading can result in losses. The supplied material does not show the exchanges' eligibility terms, so it cannot establish that the offers conceal them from viewers or misstate what viewers can receive.

citations.quote: DELTA EXCHANGE - 10% fee discount for the first 6 months + up to $30.000 in bonus!
Any affiliate links in the description of these videos may provide a commission if you decide to purchase their products.
Investing and trading is risky, and you can lose your money.

opening.argument: The chart commentary makes this look like a straightforward price update, but the description gives that attention a commercial destination. After introducing the analysis, it lists exchange bonuses and discount links, then explicitly asks viewers to use the affiliate links to support the channel. On that reading, the analysis is also a way to bring interested viewers to sign-up offers. The issue is not whether the chart is real; it is whether the surrounding presentation steers viewers from market commentary toward claiming rewards through the promoted links.

citations.quote: In this video, I analyze the current price of Chainlink and provide a Chainlink price update.
BingX up to 4000,- $ Bonus at 👉 https://bingx.com/partner/joinandcoin 👈 Bybit bonus up to $1.500 sign up at 👉 https://bit.ly/3hdzvFc 👈
If you want to support us, use any of the affiliate links above and leave a like & subscribe, thank you!

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense's chart evidence establishes that analysis occurs; it does not establish that promotion is incidental. The description asks viewers to use the affiliate links, and its instruction to register and deposit is more consequential than the spoken request to like or subscribe. The commission disclosure makes the promotional purpose explicit. A genuine market discussion can still be the vehicle that directs viewers to reward-based sign-ups.

citations.quote: If you want to support us, use any of the affiliate links above and leave a like & subscribe, thank you!
Register now; it takes only seconds; deposit & claim BONUS!
Any affiliate links in the description of these videos may provide a commission if you decide to purchase their products.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotional purpose alone does not establish a scam. The channel openly identifies the links as affiliate links and discloses possible commissions. Meanwhile, the speaker discusses downside levels and a possible rejection as well as an upside attempt, which is consistent with market analysis rather than a guaranteed-reward pitch. The prosecution's quotes show monetization alongside analysis, but not that the analysis or linked offers are deceptive.
